title: Find the name of the home team that lost the fewest matches in the 2015/201
question: Find the name of the home team that lost the fewest matches in the 2015/2016 season among leagues where the total number of goals scored (home + away) was above the overall average across all leagues.

prediction.sql:
WITH league_goals AS (
  SELECT m."XCL_008" AS league_id, SUM(m."XCL_015" + m."XCL_016") AS total_goals
  FROM "Match" m
  WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY m."XCL_008"
),
avg_goals AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_goals) AS avg_total FROM league_goals
),
qual_leagues AS (
  SELECT lg.league_id FROM league_goals lg, avg_goals ag WHERE lg.total_goals > ag.avg_total
),
home_losses AS (
  SELECT m."XCL_013" AS home_team_id, COUNT(*) AS losses
  FROM "Match" m
  WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
    AND m."XCL_008" IN (SELECT league_id FROM qual_leagues)
    AND m."XCL_015" < m."XCL_016"
  GROUP BY m."XCL_013"
)
SELECT t."XCL_173"
FROM home_losses hl
JOIN "Team" t ON t."XCL_171" = hl.home_team_id
ORDER BY hl.losses ASC
LIMIT 1

    SELECT 
        L.XCL_003 AS LeagueID,
        SUM(M.XCL_010 + M.XCL_011) AS TotalGoals

    JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_007
    WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY L.XCL_003
),

    SELECT AVG(TotalGoals) AS AvgTotalGoals
    FROM LeagueGoals
),
FilteredLeagues AS (
    SELECT LG.LeagueID
    FROM LeagueGoals LG
    JOIN AvgGoals AG ON 1=1
    WHERE LG.TotalGoals > AG.AvgTotalGoals
),
HomeTeamLosses AS (
    SELECT 
        M.XCL_013 AS HomeTeamID,
        COUNT(*) AS Losses
    FROM Match M
    JOIN FilteredLeagues FL ON M.XCL_007 = FL.LeagueID
    WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND M.XCL_010 < M.XCL_011
    GROUP BY M.XCL_013
)
SELECT 
    T.XCL_173 AS HomeTeamName
FROM HomeTeamLosses HTL
JOIN Team T ON HTL.HomeTeamID = T.XCL_171
ORDER BY HTL.Losses ASC
LIMIT 1
